'''Bicha''' was a [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. Bicha and [[Tiraca]] were the parents of their daughter, [[Pinani]]. Both parents [[Death/Legends|died]] in a march on their town by the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] sometime prior to the [[Battle of Bin]].
